description:
Portex is a Power Pages developer IDE that runs inside XrmToolBox. It puts portal files, security, queries, and a live site preview in one workspace. Dataverse is the source of truth; Azure DevOps is an optional lock-and-commit mirror. It uses the Dataverse connection you already have in XrmToolBox — no app registration required.

Edit web templates and other portal files in a Monaco editor with an offline workspace. See web roles and permissions as a graph. Run FetchXML, Web API, and Liquid as a portal contact. Open the live site already signed in as a chosen profile.
summary: A Power Pages IDE for XrmToolBox: edit portal files, audit security, run queries as a contact, and preview the live site.
title: Power Pages Editor (Portex)
